rationale: The chain class is 419 edges in the corpus and every one of its rules was measured rather than assumed: all four combinators produce it; ADJACENT pairs are joined, not just the ends; the right part's qualifiers are dropped while the left part's are not; and each part must be a SINGLE simple selector, so a compound like `ul.square` is not a chain part. Nesting is pinned in both forms — explicit `& .title` and implicit `.body`, which CSS nests as a descendant and which an oracle handling only `&` drops entirely.
_targetSpelling: CSS-D15: a target that names a declaration THIS file publishes is spelled `<file-scope>::<name>`, where the scope is the file's project-relative path without its extension. The bare spelling stays for a target this file does not declare (a cross-file or external reference) and for `imports`, whose target is another file's module name.
